FHReg_GUSO.training_domain: author-described GUSO-based pretraining; no OS adaptation here; satellite-scene overlap cannot be independently excluded
FHReg_GUSO.input: primary OpenCVlinear256->512 optical3/SARrepeated3; CPU TF.to_tensor-equivalent/255; native sample512; retain full4096coarse positions
FHReg_GUSO.geometry: raw official correspondences -> common affine RANSAC, replacing native FSC; no additional KDE cap
FHReg_GUSO.coordinate_restore: OpenCV halfpixel512->256 for both predicted endpoints; no ad-hoc stride shift

GDROS_WHU.input: OpenCV linear256->512, opticalRGB + SARrepeatedRGB, FP32 raw0..255; official model internally normalizes2*(image/255)-1
GDROS_WHU.native_LSR_slice: flattened[10000:210000], unchanged official unweighted LSR function; LSRnet checkpoint not used by test.py
GDROS_WHU.main_geometry: every original raw512 dense flow position -> predicted correspondence -> common validity filter -> common affine RANSAC; no fixedK or extra truncation
GDROS_WHU.supplementary: native raw dense and native32+LSR dense independently evaluated at same fixed valid probes; separate protocol, not common-affine frontier
GDROS_WHU.OS_weight: excluded: author training sample split overlap with our952 cannot be confirmed

RIFT2.scope: runtime/dependency audit only; MATLAB ComputerVision FAST/matchFeatures, ImageProcessing, parfor support; no silent Python replacement
RIFT2.status: MATLAB/Octave not found in local/server PATH, no numerical baseline until official runtime can run
RIFT2.resource_reporting: CPU RAM and latency separately; zero CUDA allocation is not total-memory advantage

protocol.validation: all952 fixed T05 validation pairs and saved affine transforms; test unused; no threshold selection
protocol.common_geometry: unchanged T05 independent16x16probes, full affine RANSAC config/seed/failure denominator; only predicted correspondences fit the transform
protocol.common_validity: same finite/bounds0..255/bilinear suppliedmask>.999; estimator retains originalscore>=0 check; chunkedremap for>32767points; noGT filtering
protocol.native_budgets: FH512 complete64x64 coarse/fine, FH256 complete32x32; GDROS32iterations/dense512^2; no sharedK cap; only T05_Uniform256 fixed256 descriptor queries
protocol.smoke: official repository native sample, exact wrapper preprocessing/coordinate checks, then first2 fixedT10 train-source pairs; no test/val tuning

timing.boundary: CPUresident256uint8 images+masks -> all preprocessing/H2D/uncached native model/postprocessing/coordinateD2H/filter/full affineRANSAC; excludes IO/GT/synthetic image creation/initialization
timing.memory: fresh process per method, full PyTorch peak allocated; context/reserved separately noted
timing.native_GDROS_timing: separate32+LSR output boundary, do not substitute native timing for common-affine accuracy

protocol.budget: set from jointly measured non-dominated points; pick one actual qualifying reference, never mix independent maxima/minima across methods

FHReg_GUSO_256.scope: predeclared input-resolution sensitivity, not selected by validation outcome
FHReg_GUSO_256.note: officialOSscript does not enforce resize; unusedimsize512 field is not an implementation guarantee

dependency_environment: runs/sar_references_v1/.venv; system-site torch shared read-only; new deps installed only here
compatibility: FH uses PL2profilers namespace alias for native PL1import; native inference only PassThroughProfiler; no core model/forward changes; mamba built with CUDA12.8includingSM120
